name: FedRAMP Moderate
description: Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program — government-wide program providing a standardized approach to security assessment, authorization, and continuous monitoring for cloud products and services.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, disseminate, and review/update access control policy and procedures addressing purpose, scope, roles, responsibilities, management commitment, coordination, and compliance.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Define and document the types of accounts allowed and specifically prohibited for use within the information system. Establish conditions for group and role membership.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: The information system enforces approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources in accordance with applicable access control policies.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish and document usage restrictions, configuration/connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify the types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function and coordinate the event logging function.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity, report findings to designated officials.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: Protect audit information and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Develop a system-level continuous monitoring strategy and implement continuous monitoring in accordance with the organization-level continuous monitoring strategy.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop, document, and maintain under configuration control, a current baseline configuration of the information system.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.description: Establish and document configuration settings for information technology products employed within the information system that reflect the most restrictive mode consistent with operational requirements.

controls.title: System Backup
controls.description: Conduct backups of user-level information, system-level information, and system documentation including security information at defined frequencies.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: The information system uniquely identifies and authenticates organizational users (or processes acting on behalf of organizational users).

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage information system authenticators by verifying identity, establishing initial authenticator content, ensuring procedures for safeguarding authenticators.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Implement an incident handling capability for security incidents that includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance
controls.description: Approve and monitor nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic activities and require that the nonlocal maintenance be implemented with strong authenticators.

controls.title: Media Sanitization
controls.description: Sanitize information system media prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse using sanitization mechanisms.

controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
controls.description: Develop, approve, and maintain a list of individuals with authorized access to the facility where the information system resides.

controls.title: System Security Plan
controls.description: Develop a security plan for the information system that provides an overview of security requirements and a description of the security controls in place.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.description: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the information system and hosted applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities are identified.

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.description: Require the developer of the information system, system component, or information system service to create and implement a security and privacy assessment plan.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries within the system.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: The information system protects the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at information system entry and exit points.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the information system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks, unauthorized local, network, and remote connections.
